about.label: About Me
about.heading: Driving Growth Through Strategic SEO
about.description:
With over 5 years of hands-on experience in search engine optimization, I specialize in crafting comprehensive SEO strategies that deliver measurable results. From technical audits to content strategies, I've helped businesses across e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, and local markets achieve sustainable organic growth.

My approach combines deep technical knowledge with creative content thinking — because great SEO isn't just about algorithms, it's about understanding people and building experiences that search engines love to rank.
